payload.title: RACE START — GREEN FLAG
payload.detail: Standing start completed. Green flag racing underway across all sectors.

payload.title: CAR 31 (OCON) RETIRED IN PIT LANE
payload.detail: Car 31 entered pit lane with hydraulic leak. Confirmed retirement.

payload.title: CAR 20 (MAGNUSSEN) STOPPED — WELLINGTON STRAIGHT
payload.detail: Car 20 stopped on track with power unit smoke and fire. Marshals deployed with extinguishers.

payload.title: VIRTUAL SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED
payload.detail: Virtual Safety Car deployed to allow recovery vehicle entry for Car 20. Delta time enforced.

payload.title: SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED
payload.detail: Physical Safety Car deployed due to track contamination and heavy recovery crane on Wellington Straight.

payload.title: SAFETY CAR IN THIS LAP
payload.detail: Track clear. All debris recovered. Safety Car lights out, entering pit lane at end of lap 39.

payload.title: TRACK CLEAR — GREEN FLAG RESUMED
payload.detail: Green flag racing resumed at start/finish line. DRS enabled on lap 42.

payload.title: CAR 10 (GASLY) RETIRED — SUSPENSION DAMAGE
payload.detail: Car 10 suffered right rear suspension failure following turn 16 contact with Car 18. Pitted and retired.

payload.title: STEWARDS DECISION DOC 49: 5-SECOND PENALTY CAR 18
payload.detail: Car 18 (Stroll) penalized 5 seconds added to elapsed race time for causing a collision with Car 10 at Turn 16.
payload.regulatory_reference: FIA F1 Sporting Regulations Art 38.3 & Appendix L Ch IV

payload.title: CHEQUERED FLAG — RACE FINISH
payload.detail: 52 laps completed. Winner: Car 1 (Verstappen), P2: Car 4 (Norris), P3: Car 44 (Hamilton).
